_comment: Device-scoped allowlist (spec §7). An ALLOWLIST, not a blocklist: a device
or app KAVACH has never heard of is denied by default. Ask before adding.
IMPORTANT — the two devices are governed differently, because the servers
mac    — the MCP tools are APP-scoped (AppleScript names the app it is
talking to), so the unit of permission is the app.
iphone — mirroir-mcp's tools are DEVICE-scoped. screenshot,
describe_screen and start_recording all operate on whatever is
on the phone screen; none of them take an app name. A per-app
iPhone allowlist is therefore NOT ENFORCEABLE through this
server, and listing app names here would be security theatre.
The unit of permission is the tool instead: reading is allowed,
Bundle IDs were read off this machine — note Calendar is com.apple.iCal.

iphone._note: Set enabled=false to cut the iPhone off entirely, in one edit.
